parsed.change_summary: Added input validation to ensure the number entered by the user is within the bounds of an int.
parsed.how_trigger_is_blocked: The trigger is blocked because the code now checks if the input number is within the valid range of an int (INT_MIN to INT_MAX). If the input is outside this range, the program prints an error message and continues to prompt the user for input, thus preventing any potential integer overflow or wraparound.
parsed.behavior_changes: The program now validates user input to ensure it is within the bounds of an int. If the input is invalid, the program will prompt the user to enter a valid integer again.
